scope: Public website and untrusted Python/C/C++ submissions on the existing PC; no repository visibility, SSH, logout design or database schema changes

changes.browser: Pages static responses enforce CSP, HSTS, frame, MIME, referrer and permissions policies; API adds base-uri/object-src denial
changes.sandbox: Deny all native SysV IPC, keyring, BPF and perf_event_open calls on x86_64/aarch64; preserve ordinary process/thread operations and anonymous stream socketpairs
changes.tls: certifi 2026.10.19 pinned in direct requirements and host lock; installed from the reviewed offline wheel; CI audits both dependency inputs

database_catalog_review.provider_leaked_password_protection_warn: Still disabled; Supabase handles OTP while application passwords use the existing custom verifier; no password screening added

secret_review.historical_flag_review: Template file hash, two numeric GRADER_ACCEPT_JOBS examples, RPC name and public build fingerprint; no credential identified; history was not rewritten

operator_choices.sandbox_api_restrictions: Explicitly approved after compatibility impact explained
operator_choices.ssh: Explicitly retained existing configuration; all-interface SSH with passwords remains, Internet reachability depends on router/network
operator_choices.logout: Explicitly retained browser-only logout; copied valid session/remember cookies are not individually revoked by logout
operator_choices.ubuntu_updates: Explicitly deferred: cached upgrade simulation showed 37 upgrades, zero additions/removals, two not upgraded. No OS update or reboot performed in this release.

rollout.installer_issue: A private installer umask made new certifi files root-only and temporarily prevented API startup during the fenced rollout. Corrected public package permissions, verified import/CA loading as the API user, then reopened admission. Credentials stayed private.

limits: Scoped regression and live checks are not a guarantee against all vulnerabilities or host kernel escapes
Judge processes share the host kernel; no VM boundary added
Public abuse and sustained-user load were not exhaustively tested
Per-test descendant memory attribution remains distinct from whole-job cgroup containment
SSH and copied-cookie logout risks were retained by explicit operator choice
Pending Ubuntu updates were explicitly deferred by the operator; OS patch completeness is not claimed
